description: Metadata-only registry of Jovie credentials. Never put a secret value here. Each credential claims secret names (regex, anchored) in the stores below; scripts/credentials-spend-check.mjs evaluates expiry, ownership and consumers.

owners.tim: Founder; holds provider accounts and payment.

credentials.label: Summer Gateway recovery grant
credentials.scope: Cash trial authority for AI Gateway recovery: $50/day, $50 total, cashApproved.
credentials.rotation: No renewal by design; a new grant needs a new owner receipt (JOV-8272).
credentials.blastRadius: Summer paid model turns stop at expiry. This lapse caused the 2026-10-18..20 outage.
credentials.retireAction: expired 2026-10-18 but SUMMER_GATEWAY_RECOVERY_ENABLED is still true; set false and remove the declaration

credentials.label: Summer Gateway successor grant
credentials.scope: Cash trial authority: $2/day, $4 total.
credentials.blastRadius: Summer paid turns on the successor route.
credentials.retireAction: expired 2026-10-15 but SUMMER_GATEWAY_SUCCESSOR_ENABLED is still true; set false and remove the declaration

credentials.label: Summer provider fallback grant
credentials.scope: Cloudflare Workers AI fallback cash trial: $2/day, $4 total.
credentials.retireAction: expired 2026-10-07; flag already false but SUMMER_JEV_ENABLED=true still points at the expired trial; remove both

credentials.label: Summer grant declarations (catch-all)
credentials.scope: Any future dated Summer provider declaration. The live check reads each *_GRANT expiresAt from Vercel.

credentials.label: Summer monthly Gateway budget
credentials.scope: Standing $100/UTC-month AI Gateway budget, existing credits only, no top-up, alerts 50/80/100, breaker at cap.
credentials.blastRadius: Summer stops paid turns until next UTC month at the cap. It draws on the shared Gateway credit balance, so the balance runs out before the cap.

credentials.label: Summer Linear static token
credentials.scope: Linear personal API keys acting for Summer (orchestration, governor).
credentials.rotation: Replace with the client-credentials app (pending, Tim creates in Linear UI), then remove the static token.
credentials.blastRadius: Summer cannot verify linearIssueCreate; issue writes act as a person.
credentials.notes: Linear personal API keys do not expire; capability check reports static-token-cannot-verify.

credentials.label: Summer Linear app (client credentials)
credentials.scope: Linear OAuth app 'Summer', client credentials, scopes read + issues:create.
credentials.rotation: Client-credentials access tokens last 30 days and are re-minted by Summer.

credentials.label: Summer webhook secrets
credentials.scope: Inbound webhook verification for GitHub, Linear, Sentry, Stripe, RevenueCat and iMessage.
credentials.rotation: Rotate at the provider and Vercel together.
credentials.blastRadius: Forged or dropped events into Summer.

credentials.label: Summer signing keys
credentials.scope: Bottleneck receipt/outbox signing and verification keys, commissioning attestation, mesh registries.
credentials.rotation: Key-id rotation with overlap on producer and verifier.
credentials.blastRadius: Receipts fail verification; Symphony to Summer handoffs stop.

credentials.label: Summer GitHub read token
credentials.scope: Actions read for CI failure signals.
credentials.rotation: Replace with a Jovie Bot installation token.
credentials.blastRadius: Summer CI signals lose failing-job detail.
credentials.notes: Expiry not readable without the token owner's settings page; if fine-grained, GitHub shows it there.

credentials.label: Summer gbrain client
credentials.scope: gbrain MCP client for Summer.
credentials.rotation: Reissue in gbrain, set in Vercel.

credentials.label: Summer Cloudflare Workers AI token
credentials.scope: Workers AI:Read for the fallback route.
credentials.rotation: Scoped API token in Cloudflare dashboard.
credentials.notes: Not provisioned in any store as of 2026-10-20.

credentials.label: Jovie Bot GitHub App
credentials.scope: Installation on all JovieInc repos: actions, checks, contents, issues, pull_requests, statuses, workflows = write; metadata read.
credentials.rotation: Generate a new private key in the app settings, update GitHub secrets + Vercel, revoke the old key.
credentials.blastRadius: Org-wide write to code, workflows and PR state.

credentials.label: GitHub personal access tokens
credentials.scope: Personal access tokens used by the HUD, dispatch and tooling.

credentials.notes: Org fine-grained PAT listing returned 404 (needs org owner scope), so expiry is not machine-readable yet.

credentials.label: Non-secret config held as secrets
